argument_summary: The admissible record does not support a clean claim that certification is already compliant on the existing artifact set. It does support a narrower position: aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents make certification directionally supportable, but only on a caveated basis because the pharmacy prior-authorization slice shows a current material regression and the record does not include an updated current-release disclosure artifact or approved mitigation. The overbroad claim should therefore be narrowed from 'certifiable now on the present record' to 'supportable for certification only if the current model card/certification packet is aligned to current results and explicitly discloses the pharmacy limitation.'
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is offered as a basis to alter the policy result. If rollout delay exists, it is not admissible support for treating stale approval as sufficient governance cover.
claims_about_policy: Policy does not allow prior approval or informal monitoring comments to substitute for current-release documentation, current evaluation evidence, or approved risk acceptance. The admissible evidence is consistent with treating aggregate readiness as supportive context, not as satisfaction of the disclosure requirement. The appropriate policy treatment is caveated compliance, not clean compliance, unless the auditor already has separate admissible proof that current-release documentation was updated.
concessions: The current admissible record does not contain the updated model card, disclosure text, or approved mitigation for the pharmacy subgroup weakness.
The prior approval predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot by itself carry the current release.
The informal monitoring comment is context only and is not a reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure artifact.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private or side-channel material is relied on as public support.
